text:
Prepositions and their roles:
1. onto: Connects the verb "jumped" to the noun phrase "the counter," indicating direction and destination.
2. in: Connects the noun phrase "search" to the prepositional phrase "of food," indicating the context or container of the search.
3. of: Connects the noun "search" to the noun "food," indicating the object or purpose of the search.
4. of: Connects the adjective "unaware" to the noun phrase "the water," indicating the object of the awareness (or lack thereof).
5. across: Connects the noun phrase "the water" to the noun phrase "the surface," indicating the spatial relationship or path of the water.

Shape with three sides: Triangle
